subject: new geomorph and RRPP versions on CRAN

messages.subject: new geomorph and RRPP versions on CRAN
parts:
Colleagues, 

 

A new version of geomorph (4.0.10) and a new version of RRPP (2.1.0) are both available on CRAN.  The packages now include expanded output and graphical options that accompany the exploration of dimensions of phylogenetic signal based on methods in Mitteroecker, Collyer, and Adams (2025), found using the physignal.eigen’ function. In particular, the K-components are included, which allow additional plots found in the original paper. Note that an update to RRPP to version 2.1.0 is required.

 

As always, other changes are found in the NEWS files of both packages.


Happy computing!

 

Dean (on behalf of the geomorph team)

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams
